In the Trenches, Lessons Learned from Real-life Audit Experiences

View the webinar Here

Eric Christensen , Director of Client Services and Chad Schiffman , Director of Compliance, invite you to join them for our September webinar.

Healthcare practices are faced with potential audits all the time. From completing questionnaires, to filling out requests for information, audits can be a cumbersome, time-consuming process.

Healthcare Compliance Pros (HCP) has helped our clients large and small navigate the process and understand how to quickly get back to what you do best, managing your practice. We know what the OIG, OCR and other entities are looking for and how to satisfy your requirements in the least amount of time.

  • What are the audits trying to accomplish?
  • How can your practice concisely and effectively become "audit-proof," no matter which audit request you receive?
  • Where are your audits risks, and how can you document your efforts?
